title: PaquetExpress Tracking Results
description: Shipment tracking details scraped from paquetexpress.com.mx. One item per tracking number, including a human-readable Markdown rendering and the electronic signature image when delivered.

trackingNumber.title: Tracking Number
trackingNumber.description: PaquetExpress tracking number as shown on the tracking page

guide.title: Guide
guide.description: Guide (guía) code assigned to the shipment

shippingDate.title: Shipping Date
shippingDate.description: Shipping date as displayed on the tracking page

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Origin branch code, city/state, and country

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Destination branch code, city/state, and country

status.title: Status
status.description: Current status (last reached step in the stepper)

statusStep.title: Status Step
statusStep.description: 1-based index of the current status within the steps list

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: All status steps of the delivery pipeline

estimatedDeliveryDate.title: Estimated Delivery Date
estimatedDeliveryDate.description: Estimated delivery date when shown (empty once delivered)

electronicSignature.title: Electronic Signature
electronicSignature.description: Firma electrónica image as base64 data URI with mimeType and bytes; present only when delivered

movements.title: Movements
movements.description: Tracking history entries with time, date, description, and location (newest first)

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Human-readable Markdown rendering of the record (present when markdownOutput is true)

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: Tracking page URL the record was scraped from

error.title: Error
error.description: Set to 'not_found' or 'request_failed' when no tracking data was found for the input

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per tracking number with guide, status, and timestamps.
